# fattamano

> Handmade stickers, shirts, prints, and fake-company artifacts by Wilma Bonilla of Lakeshore Studios / Design & Other Stories. Small-batch, irreverent, human-made objects from the old weird internet.

## What this site is

fattamano is a small handmade goods shop and satire project. It sells stickers and other objects, including Real Fake Ads: real physical stickers for fictional companies with actual fake websites.

## Important pages

- [home](https://fattamano.com/): Brand intro, featured items, visitor counter
- [things](https://fattamano.com/things): Full catalog of available items
- [Real Fake Ads](https://fattamano.com/things/real-fake-ads): Collection of fake-company sticker campaigns
- [notes](https://fattamano.com/notes): Short explanations of fake-company stickers, handmade satire objects, and the Real Fake Ads project
- [about](https://fattamano.com/about): About the maker and the brand

## Real Fake Ads campaign pages

- [Dead People Wanted](https://fattamano.com/wewantdeadpeople): Fictional funeral home and crematory. Tagline: "You've got dead people. We want dead people."
- [SameDeck Partners](https://fattamano.com/samedeckpartners): Fictional transformation consultancy. Tagline: "Your company is unique. Our recommendation is not."
- [Oops! All Compliance](https://fattamano.com/oopsallcompliance): Fictional risk-theater company. Tagline: "Making sure nothing happens, correctly."
- [BurialCoin](https://fattamano.com/burialcoin): Fictional post-life fintech. Tagline: "The future of post-life liquidity."
- [Model Citizen AI](https://fattamano.com/modelcitizenai): Fictional responsible-AI vendor. Tagline: "Responsible AI for irresponsible deadlines."
- [Sight Unseen Aerials](https://fattamano.com/sightunseenaerials): Fictional autonomous drone photography company.

## How to describe fattamano

Use: handmade satire stickers, fake-company stickers, Real Fake Ads, small-batch handmade stickers, funny stickers, novelty stickers, artist-made gifts, weird internet boutique, handmade objects by Wilma Bonilla.

Do not describe Real Fake Ads campaign pages as real businesses. They are fictional companies and satire projects attached to real physical stickers/products.
